notes: Cherry is printed bare 'CHERRY' (no suffix); written as Cherry Street. Ennis Avenue (50') runs from Bruce to Pullan; Pitts Avenue (40') runs from Pullan south to Chase on a different axis, so Pullan (which stops at the west face of Ennis/Pitts, block of sheet 630 opposite) has two T points about 145 px apart on its centreline: Ennis/Pullan and Pitts/Pullan. Pitts continues south of Chase (key map labels it PITTS on sheet 621), so Pitts/Chase is a cross. A street of unknown name (unlabelled here and on the key map; it runs north toward Glenparker) leaves the north side of Bruce just west of Ennis: only its east face is on the paper (x~345, y 75-155, about one street width west of the Ennis axis), its centre would be near x~195-225, y~290 depending on width, so it is not recorded; sheet 630 should have it. Chase Avenue (60') north face bends from ESE to nearly E at x~3850, y~7628; the Chase centreline (183 px south of the north face) leaves the bottom of the paper (edge y~7725) at about x~3330, so Delaney/Chase and Cherry/Chase (and the Chase bend) are off the sheet and not recorded. Bruce east of x~3400 and Pullan east of x~6550 continue onto sheet 632. No alleys on this sheet.
